$comment: Pre-existing component-derived contrast debt, ledgered at the landing of RAIL-COMPONENT-CONTRAST-01. Two-directional ratchet: a failing pair NOT listed here fails generate:check, and an entry that no longer reproduces a failing pair fails as stale (delete it when fixed). fg/bg are terminal identities — a global token path or a literal hex — exactly as derived by component-contrast.ts. Entries match per (component, fg, bg) across themes, scopes, and blocks. This ledger can only shrink truthfully.

gaps.note: Trigger hover: light 4.38:1, dark 1.92:1. The hover text token does not flip per theme while the hover background does, so dark-mode hover text is near-invisible against the hover surface. Token-side fix: make semantic.interaction.text.hover theme-aware.
Light 4.38:1 (dark passes at 4.98:1). Secondary text on the secondary surface sits just under AA. Same root-cause token pair as ShowMore and Status; one token-side fix burns all three entries.
Light 4.38:1. Root cause identical to the Blockquote entry (same fg/bg token pair).
Light 4.38:1. Root cause identical to the Blockquote entry (same fg/bg token pair).
Dark 3.60:1 (light passes at 4.74:1). Trigger/option hover pair is under AA in dark mode only. Token-side fix: widen the dark hover fg/bg spread.

Light 3.11:1 on the prev button. The background chain terminates at core.color.mode.transparent, which resolves to OPAQUE #000000 — a token named transparent carrying black. Either the name or the value is wrong; whichever is repaired, re-derive this pair before deleting the entry.
